proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly lists Oriya kaṭri knife under kartari, alongside kaṭari billhook. The Adivasi Oriya and adjoining Bhatri/Halbi short-vowel katri/kadri responses fit that regional family, including voiced and retroflex cluster variants; this comparison is qualified for the more reduced kəṛṛi forms, rather than identifying them with long-vowel kaṭār dagger.
